---
name: vibe-acceptance-auditor
description: Independently check full KMP delivery against its approved AppSpec and actual production behavior; report gaps without implementing fixes.
---

# Vibe Acceptance Auditor

Review code and evidence independently. The implementation conversation is not an input. Never edit production, tests, configuration, dependencies, AppSpec or delivery state. Check commands may update build caches and write logs/receipts. The launcher writes audit/launch artifacts.

Read the immutable request first. For `mode: lean`, follow [lean-audit.md](references/lean-audit.md). For a Protocol 2.0 strict request, follow [strict-audit.md](references/strict-audit.md). Missing formal intermediate handoffs are not gaps in lean delivery. Bounded maintenance does not automatically require this full audit.

Build the normative inventory from AppSpec prose, flows, screens, ACs, managed operations and gates before trusting implementer claims. Trace real entry point  state/actions  domain/data/platform  observable result  meaningful assertions and completed checks. Inspect failure, restart, cancellation and lifecycle branches. Flag demo/fake production paths, unused assets, disconnected settings and tests that bypass actual wiring.

Use every required verification surface. Reuse current executed checks after examining their assertions and logs. Run missing or suspect checks. Distinguish unsupported host execution from a repository-verifiable failure; compilation never substitutes for iOS simulator/runtime evidence.

For Android, verify the shared [Android minimum SDK contract](../vibe-developer/references/android-platform-contract.md): `minSdk >= 24` in effective configuration and applicable built manifests. Report lower values as gaps; release readiness also needs the release AAB check when distribution is in scope.

For UI review actual primary-screen goldens and distinct rendering risks, localization/accessibility, assets and production use. Group repeated design patterns instead of requiring per-control paperwork. User/AppSpec requirements take precedence over default matrix size.

Return PASS only when all available requirements are independently substantiated and no local gap remains; otherwise GAPS or BLOCKED with exact obligation, failed link and smallest useful proof. External limitations prevent full completion as appropriate. A prior PASS is stale after changed inputs until revalidated. An auditor must never implement its own findings.
# Lean independent acceptance

The lean request fixes AppSpec/workspace fingerprints and unavailable host pairs. Read normative AppSpec sources before work.json or implementer summaries. Inventory approved/excluded requirements, ACs, managed operations and gates using the shared canonical helpers. Inspect normative omissions in prose too. Record reviewed Markdown paths once; no heading-by-heading justification for contextual prose.

Inspect every required `(obligation, surface)` pair from `verification_surface_map(app)` in `vibe_protocol.py`. For each verified pair record real production and test anchors, the assertion that proves behavior, and executed check receipts. Inspect receipt tasks and logs; a zero exit code alone, an unrelated assertion, skipped tests or an unconnected preview is insufficient. Check shared fixtures against actual production graph and platform wiring.

Run missing safe checks using `lean-delivery.py <repo> check`. Use `--runner gradle` for Gradle to hold the workspace mutex. Current global receipts may be reused without running the same matrix again. Do not change source/tests to make an audit pass. The launcher persists your final JSON; never create launch evidence yourself.

Return JSON with:

```json
{
  "requestSha256": "actual request file sha256",
  "startedAt": "actual RFC3339 time",
  "completedAt": "actual RFC3339 time",
  "inventory": {"requirementIds": [], "excludedRequirementIds": [], "acceptanceScenarioIds": [], "managedOperationIds": [], "qualityGateIds": []},
  "reviewedSources": ["product.md", "domain.md", "data.md", "design.md", "quality.md", "flows/FLOW-001.md", "screens/SCREEN-001.md"],
  "obligations": [
    {"id": "AC-001", "surface": "component-test", "result": "verified",
     "production": [{"path": "shared/feature/Example.kt", "symbol": "ExampleComponent"}],
     "tests": [{"path": "shared/feature/ExampleTest.kt", "symbol": "saveSurvivesRestart"}],
     "assertion": "Describe the observed production path and actual assertions, including restart.",
     "receiptRefs": [".vibe/receipts/RECEIPT-real-id.json"]}
  ],
  "findings": [],
  "verdict": "PASS"
}
```

Use actual inventory, paths, symbols, times and receipts. Include all pairs, not only the illustration. `result` is `verified`, `gap`, `unavailable` or `not-applicable`. Gaps need reason and actionable findings. Unavailable is only for exact host pairs in the request; inspect the implementation that can be checked locally. Not-applicable is only for inactive conditional external/release gates and must name the condition and why it is inactive. No implicit waivers of repository behavior.

For the independent audit surface of the closure gate, use `result: verified`, `auditEvidence: true` and an assertion explaining the inventory/wiring review; the launcher/validator supplies its own execution proof instead of requiring a recursively pre-existing audit receipt. This exception applies only to a surface named `independent-audit` or `acceptance-audit` or `audit` on a gate, never to product tests.

PASS means all locally available obligations are proven, no local gap or finding remains. GAPS lists known missing behavior/evidence; BLOCKED explains why a reliable assessment is unavailable. Completion flags are computed by the host, not invented by the auditor. For delta review, inspect changed file hashes and consumers, close previous findings with new proof and return a complete current inventory. Request a fresh full audit if scope or independence no longer permits delta review.

package com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.component

import com.arkivanov.decompose.DefaultComponentContext
import com.arkivanov.essenty.lifecycle.LifecycleRegistry
import com.arkivanov.essenty.lifecycle.destroy
import com.arkivanov.essenty.lifecycle.resume
import com.arkivanov.mvikotlin.main.store.DefaultStoreFactory
import com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.component.integration.ScreenComponentDependencies
import com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.component.integration.ScreenComponentFactory
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.Channel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.UnconfinedTestDispatcher
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
import kotlin.test.*

/** The only supplied boundary is a cold read flow; public components own all failure/retry/draft transitions. */
class ScreenObservationRetryTest {
    @Test
    fun firstReadConstructionFailureCanRetryWithoutLosingAuthoredDraftOrGeneratedIdentity() = runTest {
        val manager = ReadManager()
        val read = manager.route(ScreenId.ZONES).apply {
            constructionFailure = ReadFailure()
            baseline = fields("id" to "generated-zone", "name" to "Stored shelf", "capacity" to "2")
        }
        Fixture(ScreenId.ZONES, manager, UnconfinedTestDispatcher(testScheduler)).use { fixture ->
            val component = fixture.component
            assertEquals(LoadState.ERROR, component.model.value.loadState)
            assertEquals(READ_ERROR, component.model.value.errorKey)
            component.onAction(ScreenAction.EditField(ScreenFieldId("name"), " My shelf Ж "))
            component.onAction(ScreenAction.Retry)
            assertEquals(LoadState.CONTENT, component.model.value.loadState)
            assertEquals("generated-zone", component.field("id"))
            assertEquals(" My shelf Ж ", component.field("name"))
            assertTrue(component.model.value.hasUnsavedChanges)
            assertEquals(2, read.attempts)
            assertEquals(1, read.active)
        }
        assertEquals(0, read.active)
    }

    @Test
    fun failedRefreshKeepsSnapshotAndDirtyFieldsAndRetriesWithOneCollector() = runTest {
        val manager = ReadManager()
        val read = manager.route(ScreenId.ZONES).apply {
            baseline = fields("id" to "original-zone", "name" to "Stored shelf", "capacity" to "2")
        }
        Fixture(ScreenId.ZONES, manager, UnconfinedTestDispatcher(testScheduler)).use { fixture ->
            val component = fixture.component
            component.onAction(ScreenAction.EditField(ScreenFieldId("name"), "Keep my unsaved shelf"))
            read.events.send(Result.failure(ReadFailure()))
            assertEquals(LoadState.ERROR, component.model.value.loadState)
            assertEquals("original-zone", component.field("id"))
            assertEquals("Keep my unsaved shelf", component.field("name"))
            read.baseline = fields("id" to "fresh-unrelated-draft-id", "name" to "External shelf", "capacity" to "3")
            component.onAction(ScreenAction.Retry)
            component.onAction(ScreenAction.Retry)
            assertNull(component.model.value.errorKey)
            assertEquals("original-zone", component.field("id"))
            assertEquals("Keep my unsaved shelf", component.field("name"))
            assertEquals("3", component.field("capacity"))
            assertEquals(3, read.attempts)
            assertEquals(1, read.active)
            assertEquals(1, read.maximumActive)
        }
        assertEquals(0, read.active)
    }

    @Test
    fun detailFailureDoesNotHideCollectionOrDisappearOnCollectionRefreshAndRetriesOnlyDetail() = runTest {
        val manager = ReadManager()
        val collection = manager.route(ScreenId.TRAYS).apply { baseline = collection() }
        val detail = manager.route(ScreenId.BATCH_DETAIL, "second").apply { baseline = detail("second", "Last good detail") }
        Fixture(ScreenId.TRAYS, manager, UnconfinedTestDispatcher(testScheduler)).use { fixture ->
            val component = fixture.component
            component.onAction(ScreenAction.Select("second"))
            detail.events.send(Result.failure(ReadFailure()))
            assertEquals(LoadState.CONTENT, component.model.value.loadState)
            assertEquals(LoadState.ERROR, component.model.value.detail?.loadState)
            assertEquals("Last good detail", component.model.value.detail?.items?.single()?.authoredTitle)
            collection.events.send(Result.success(collection().copy(offline = false)))
            assertEquals(READ_ERROR, component.model.value.detail?.errorKey)
            assertEquals("second", component.model.value.selectedItemId)
            detail.baseline = detail("second", "Recovered exact detail")
            component.onAction(ScreenAction.Retry)
            assertEquals(1, collection.attempts)
            assertEquals(2, detail.attempts)
            assertEquals(1, detail.maximumActive)
            assertEquals(LoadState.CONTENT, component.model.value.detail?.loadState)
            assertEquals("Recovered exact detail", component.model.value.detail?.items?.single()?.authoredTitle)
        }
        assertEquals(0, collection.active)
        assertEquals(0, detail.active)
    }

    @Test
    fun failureBeforeFirstDetailEmissionStillHasExactSelectedSubjectAndPublicRetry() = runTest {
        val manager = ReadManager()
        manager.route(ScreenId.TRAYS).baseline = collection()
        val detail = manager.route(ScreenId.BATCH_DETAIL, "second").apply {
            constructionFailure = IllegalStateException("Local read unavailable")
            baseline = detail("second", "Fresh detail")
        }
        Fixture(ScreenId.TRAYS, manager, UnconfinedTestDispatcher(testScheduler)).use { fixture ->
            val component = fixture.component
            component.onAction(ScreenAction.Select("second"))
            assertEquals(LoadState.CONTENT, component.model.value.loadState)
            assertEquals(LoadState.ERROR, component.model.value.detail?.loadState)
            assertEquals(TextKey("state_error_body"), component.model.value.detail?.errorKey)
            assertEquals("second", component.model.value.detail?.selectedItemId)
            component.onAction(ScreenAction.Retry)

/** Recovery outlives a loading screen; a failed attempt can be retried without exposing its data. */
internal class WorkspaceRecoveryGate(private val scope: CoroutineScope, private val recover: suspend () -> Unit) {
    private val mutex = Mutex()
    private var attempt: Deferred<Result<Unit>>? = null
    private val mutableReady = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val ready = mutableReady.asStateFlow()

    suspend fun awaitReady() {
        val current = mutex.withLock {
            attempt?.takeUnless { it.isCancelled || (it.isCompleted && !mutableReady.value) } ?: scope.async {
                domainResult {
                    recover()
                    mutableReady.value = true
                }
            }.also { attempt = it }
        }
        current.await().getOrThrow()
    }
}

internal class RecoveryGatedScreenDataManager(
    private val delegate: ScreenDataManager,
    private val recovery: WorkspaceRecoveryGate,
) : ScreenDataManager {
    override fun watch(screen: ScreenId, stableId: String?) = flow {
        recovery.awaitReady()
        emitAll(delegate.watch(screen, stableId))
    }

    override suspend fun execute(screen: ScreenId, command: ScreenCommand) = domainResult {
        recovery.awaitReady()
        delegate.execute(screen, command).getOrThrow()
    }

    override suspend fun previewStage(command: ScreenCommand) = domainResult {
        recovery.awaitReady()
        delegate.previewStage(command).getOrThrow()
    }

    override suspend fun previewPhoto(value: String) = domainResult {
        recovery.awaitReady()
        delegate.previewPhoto(value).getOrThrow()
    }
}
